scenes.headline: How a looped DiT spends compute inside each step
scenes.sub: Loop in depth, flow in time
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Eddy! Image flow models buy quality with more sampling steps. This one adds a second dial: loops inside every step.

scenes.text: Each loop predicts its own point on a straight line from the model's first guess to the true velocity.
scenes.say: The trick is the target. Each loop predicts its own point on a line from the model's first guess to the true velocity.

steps.say: The noisy latent passes four ordinary blocks, once per step.
Then one shared stack runs again and again, with the first state added back each pass.
Each pass is told its depth, a number from zero to one.
A small head reads out the velocity, and the sampler steps.

scenes.title: What each loop is trained to output

parts.note: the first guess, with its gradient stopped
parts.say: Start from the model's own first guess.
End at the flow matching target.

parts.note: loop at depth s removes that share of the gap
parts.say: A loop at depth s closes that share of the gap. The last loop sits at one.

scenes.say: Flow matching again, one level down: a straight line, walked in depth instead of time.

scenes.title: Why it runs deeper than it trained

left.title: Every loop predicts the answer
items: The same target for every loop
left.say: If every loop must predict the answer, an extra loop has nothing to do.

right.title: Each loop gets a share
items: Depth drawn at random in training
More loops just make a finer grid
Every depth was seen in training
right.say: Here depth is random in training, so more loops just make a finer grid.

scenes.label: FID of one checkpoint trained with 2 loops, run with 16
scenes.say: Trained with two loops and run with sixteen, one checkpoint goes from seventeen to just over nine. Lower is better.

scenes.title: Same checkpoint: more steps or more loops
scenes.say: Steps cannot fix a bad velocity. One loop and a hundred steps scores about thirty. Eight loops and ten steps, about fifteen.

scenes.title: The best split uses both dials

steps.say: Map quality over steps and loops, and the best path turns between both axes.
Past a few loops, the next unit of compute belongs to steps.

scenes.text: Loops refine the velocity; steps follow it. The best budget spends on both.
scenes.say: Loops refine the velocity, steps follow it. Spend on both.
